subject: snail
pitch: A garden snail on an adventure. A glossy spiral shell striped in caramel, chocolate and cream, a soft grey-green body with a pebbly texture and a slimy shine, two long eye stalks with little black eyes and two short feelers below. A tiny ladybird hitches a ride on top of the shell.
reasoning:
I'm planning a garden snail model built with the SDK, sized realistically at around 8cm tall including the shell, with a body, spiral shell, eye stalks, feelers, and a ladybird perched on top for detail.

For the geometry, I'm defining a root joint at the body base, then building the foot and body as a tapered capsule shape, a head sphere at the front, and eye stalk joints extending upward for rigging.

Working out eye stalk chains...

For the eyes themselves, I'll add a small black sphere attached to the tip joint of each stalk chain, naming the last joint "eyeLtip" so I can bone the eye part directly to it rather than computing coordinates manually.
